title: Some people wait for perfect conditions.
paragraphs:
Some people wait for perfect conditions.
Others build anyway.
Nehemiah’s builders laid stones with one hand and carried a sword with the other.

Faith didn’t make the work easier.
It made them stay ready.
Where in your life are you being called to keep building even while fighting resistance?
Then they picked up the stones anyway.
Some seasons require both faith and readiness.
Sometimes you’re trying to build something meaningful while criticism, pressure, and resistance show up at the same time.
You don’t stop building just because opposition appears.
“Some seasons require a hammer. Some require a sword. The wise learn when to carry both.”
